scripts.build: cargo build --release --locked && npm --workspace generated-package-ui run build && node scripts/assemble-package.mjs && npm run validate:dist
scripts.typecheck: cargo check --workspace --locked && npm --workspace generated-package-ui run typecheck
scripts.lint: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings && npm --workspace generated-package-ui run lint
scripts.test: npm run validate && npm run check:vendor && cargo test --workspace --locked && npm --workspace generated-package-ui test && node --test scripts/assemble-package.test.mjs
